verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents headless batch conversion via --convert-to and --infilter, and its filter list includes DOCX (Office Open XML Text) and EPUB. A community user also reports running it in Docker to normalize document formats. That covers only part of the story's format matrix. missing for 10: Markdown, HTML, and LaTeX filters (none evidenced), confirmation of which direction the EPUB filter supports (import, export or both), and hands-on evidence of round-trip markup/e-book conversion quality.
